We propose a novel framework for learning robust probabilistic classifiers in the presence of sample selection bias.

(1) sample selection bias can cause a significant loss in classification performance, (2) existing approaches to dealing with sample selection bias suffer from estimation errors, and (3) the proposed approach can adapt to unknown sample selection bias and achieve performance that is as good as possible.
